name: Hyun Jung Lee
profile_summary: Hi! I am Hyun Jung Lee, master’s student in the AI Department at Korea University. Currently focusing on AI research, with particular interests in multimodal models, reinforcement learning, and generative methods. Passionate about applications at the intersection of medical data and multimodal learning, and exploring PhD opportunities in this field.

education.thesis: Towards Robust Peritoneal Tumor Diagnosis – Deep learning-based binary classification and detection of tumors in laparoscopic videos

experience.title: Researcher
experience.organization: Center for Biosystems and Biotech Data Science, Ghent University
bullets: Devised a DNA data augmentation method by mimicking silent mutation processes.
Predicted DNA-to-protein translation initiation likelihood with a CNN model.
Built a pre-trained CNN model for surgical datasets with self-supervised learning.

experience.title: Intern
experience.organization: Center for Biosystems and Biotech Data Science, Ghent University
bullets: Experimented on the effects of parasite infection with UMAP-based visualization.
Executed point mutations in DNA and analyzed their effect on deep neural network predictions, focusing on translation initiation site prediction.
Conducted research on object detection for medical image and video analysis.
